title: Kale Salad with Beans, Apples, Dates, Pumpkin Seeds & Crispy Parmesan

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with oil, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.

Wash and dry kale. Fold leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; finely chop leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Finely grate Parmesan. Divide into 2 piles and place on the baking sheet several inches apart from each other. Spread each pile out into a 6-inch circle.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until Parmesan is lightly browned and crisp, 5-7 minutes. (Watch carefully as the Parmesan can burn quickly.) Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander. Add to the bowl with the kale.
Wash, dry, quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop dates and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
Break crispy Parmesan into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls; top with pumpkin seeds and crispy Parmesan. Enjoy!
